title: fraxinus lanceolata var. viridis
intro: Fraxinus lanceolata var. viridis, commonly known as Green Ash, is a plant species in the family Oleaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include being an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, and having potential effects on cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus lanceolata var. viridis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
